title: Fix claude provider schema dialect handling and add live claude tests
objective: Make the claude provider pass --json-schema documents the real Claude Code CLI accepts by removing $schema dialect declarations, and add an opt-in live test suite (outside npm test) that confirms the provider end to end, including a read_file/write_file chat session.

branch.name: WI-0027-claude-schema-dialect-live-tests
branch.rationale: Each work item is processed on its own branch.

request.text: Operator request: perform live testing to confirm the claude provider is operating as expected; read_file and write_file chat-session tests should work with the claude provider. Live testing found that the real Claude Code CLI rejects --json-schema documents declaring $schema https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema, so llm summarize and llm req summarize fail with the default claude provider.

scope.name: schema-dialect
scope.description: Remove $schema keywords from every schema passed to the claude CLI as --json-schema, recursing through subschemas without deleting property names, so validation semantics are unchanged.
scope.reason: The real CLI rejects the 2020-12 dialect URI used by the bundled summarize outputSchema.

scope.name: live-tests
scope.description: Add tests/live/claude-live.mjs and npm run test:live:claude: text completion, structured output with $defs, llm summarize through the compiled CLI, and a read_file/write_file chat session, all against the real CLI and only on explicit request.
scope.reason: The operator asked for live confirmation, including read_file/write_file chat-session tests.

nonGoals.name: provider-behavior
nonGoals.description: Do not change provider selection, defaults, tool-calling semantics, or OpenRouter behavior.

nonGoals.name: live-in-npm-test
nonGoals.description: Do not add live or authenticated checks to npm test.

nonGoals.name: release
nonGoals.description: Do not publish, deploy, tag, or claim production readiness.
nonGoals.reason: The work item is local delivery.

items.name: schema-dialect
items.description: Schemas passed as --json-schema carry no $schema keywords, keep property names, and keep their validation semantics.
items.reason: The real CLI must accept generated schemas.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Object-root, wrapped, tool-envelope, and $id-scoped emitted schemas contain no $schema keyword, and a property named $schema is preserved.
Emitted schemas compile with strict Ajv 2020 and accept and reject the same values; llm summarize succeeds against the real CLI.

items.name: live-tests
items.description: An opt-in live suite confirms the claude provider against the real CLI, including a read_file/write_file chat session.

acceptanceCriteria.description: npm run test:live:claude runs text, structured-output, CLI summarize, and read_file/write_file chat-session checks against the real CLI and exits non-zero on any failure.
npm test does not include the live suite, and README.md and SKILL.md document how and when to run it.
